taskDescription: The user's goal is to transfer a specific order's details from the Valmart system to the Arco system. Start by logging into Valmart at https://valmart-ecru.vercel.app/login using the provided credentials: email 'hola@arco.com' and password '12345'. Once logged into Valmart, navigate to 'Mis Pedidos'. Then, open a new tab and log into Arco at https://arco-nine.vercel.app/login using the same credentials: email 'hola@arco.com' and password '12345'. After logging into Arco, return to the Valmart 'Mis Pedidos' page. From the list of orders, identify the order with ID 'ORD-1780819799449'. For this specific order, extract the 'ID PEDIDO', product 'NOMBRE', 'PRECIO/U', 'UNIDADES', 'SKU', 'FECHA', 'CLIENTE', and 'DIRECCIÓN'. Switch back to the Arco system, click the 'Nuevo Pedido' button, and populate the new order form with the extracted data. Specifically, map the 'ID PEDIDO' from Valmart to Arco's 'ID Pedido' field, Valmart's product 'NOMBRE' to Arco's 'Nombre del producto', Valmart's 'PRECIO/U' (removing the '$' sign) to Arco's price input (placeholder '0.00'), Valmart's 'UNIDADES' to Arco's quantity input (placeholder '1'), Valmart's 'SKU' to Arco's SKU input (placeholder '8480000239266'), Valmart's 'FECHA' to Arco's 'Fecha y Hora', Valmart's 'CLIENTE' to Arco's 'Cliente' field, and Valmart's 'DIRECCIÓN' to Arco's 'Dirección' field. Finally, click the 'Guardar Pedido' button in Arco. The task is successfully completed once the order is saved in Arco and the page navigates back to the Arco homepage.
fieldMappings: Valmart 'ID PEDIDO' → Arco 'ID Pedido'; Valmart product 'NOMBRE' → Arco 'Nombre del producto'; Valmart product 'PRECIO/U' → Arco product price (cleaned to remove '$'); Valmart product 'UNIDADES' → Arco product quantity; Valmart product 'SKU' → Arco product SKU; Valmart 'FECHA' → Arco 'Fecha y Hora'; Valmart 'CLIENTE' → Arco 'Cliente'; Valmart 'DIRECCIÓN' → Arco 'Dirección'.
